headline: Jio Futuristic Digital Holdings files SEBI substantial acquisition disclosure for Den Networks
sum: Jio Futuristic Digital Holdings Private Limited has filed a Regulation 31(4) disclosure under SEBI Takeover Regulations with NSE regarding a substantial acquisition in Den Networks Limited. The filing marks formal notification of shareholding crossing a threshold triggering mandatory disclosure.
detail: Jio Futuristic Digital Holdings Private Limited submitted a Regulation 31(4) disclosure to NSE on or around 1 July 2026 in respect of Den Networks Limited, a telecom/broadcasting entity listed on NSE. Regulation 31(4) of the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011 requires any person who acquires shares crossing specified thresholds to disclose to the target company and the stock exchange within four trading days. The disclosure is the first formal regulatory notification of the transaction.
